title: Streamera playback providers
description: Source of truth for the playback provider list rendered by WatchPage. Edited by hand or by the provider-sentinel agent; validated in CI before merge.

version.description: Config schema version. Bump only alongside a reader change in src/services/providers.ts.

id.description: Stable slug. Used as the React key and the selected-source identifier; changing it resets a user's selection.

label.description: Text shown on the source button.

host.description: Bare hostname, no scheme and no trailing slash. Substituted into {host}.

movie.description: Movie embed URL template. Must be https and contain {id}. Supports {host} and {id}.

tv.description: TV embed URL template. Must be https and contain {id}. Supports {host}, {id}, {season} and {episode}.
